statements.subject: client
statements.description: Unless there is local policy specifying otherwise, the destination MUST be determined by applying the DNS procedures described in [4] as follows.
actions: apply DNS procedures from [4] to determine destination

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the first element in the route set indicated a strict router (resulting in forming the request as described in Section 12.2.1.1), the procedures MUST be applied to the Request-URI of the request.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Independent of which URI is used as input to the procedures of [4], if the Request-URI specifies a SIPS resource, the UAC MUST follow the procedures of [4] as if the input URI were a SIPS URI.
actions: apply DNS procedures as if input URI were SIPS URI

statements.subject: sip
statements.description: Local policy MAY specify an alternate set of destinations to attempt.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the Request-URI contains a SIPS URI, any alternate destinations MUST be contacted with TLS.

statements.subject: sip
statements.description: However, that approach for configuring an outbound proxy is NOT RECOMMENDED; a pre-existing route set with a single URI SHOULD be used instead.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: However, that approach for configuring an outbound proxy is NOT RECOMMENDED; a pre-existing route set with a single URI SHOULD be used instead.
actions: use pre-existing route set with single URI for outbound proxy configuration

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the request contains a Route header field, the request SHOULD be sent to the locations derived from its topmost value, but MAY be sent to any server that the UA is certain will honor the Route and Request-URI policies specified in this document (as opposed to those in RFC 2543).
actions: send request to locations derived from topmost Route header field value

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the request contains a Route header field, the request SHOULD be sent to the locations derived from its topmost value, but MAY be sent to any server that the UA is certain will honor the Route and Request-URI policies specified in this document (as opposed to those in RFC 2543).
actions: send request to server confirmed to honor Route and Request-URI policies

statements.subject: client
statements.description: In particular, a UAC configured with an outbound proxy SHOULD attempt to send the request to the location indicated in the first Route header field value instead of adopting the policy of sending all messages to the outbound proxy.
actions: send request to location indicated in first Route header field value

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The UAC SHOULD follow the procedures defined in [4] for stateful elements, trying each address until a server is contacted.
actions: follow DNS procedures for stateful elements
try each address in ordered set until a server is contacted
create new transaction for each address attempt
